title: ZoreForge
blurb: ZoreForge is a procedural lore and world-building engine designed for generating structured narratives, entities, and systems within the Zore universe. It integrates deterministic RNG, dice-based generation systems, structured outline construction, and modular content libraries to enable scalable creation of alternate reality lore, environments, and entities.

components.name: ZoreOutline
components.description: Narrative structure generator responsible for creating hierarchical outlines of worlds, stories, entities, and systems using deterministic and probabilistic rulesets.

components.name: ZoreLibrary GUI
components.description: Graphical interface for browsing, editing, and managing generated lore, entities, and datasets within the ZoreForge ecosystem.

components.name: Dice Engine
components.description: Core randomization and probability engine implementing polyhedral dice systems, weighted distributions, and deterministic RNG pipelines.

components.name: Dice Table Scaffold
components.description: Schema and data-layer framework defining structured dice tables, lookup systems, and generation rules used by the Dice Engine.
